hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.lead: A short explanation of the data this website collects and how we use it.

sections.title: What we collect
body: When you use the contact form: your name, business name, business type, listing or Instagram link (if given), what you need, and your contact details (WhatsApp or email).
When you sign up for the Free Listing Audit: your name, property name, listing link, and contact details (WhatsApp or email).
Anonymous visit statistics, such as pages viewed and where visits come from. These statistics use no cookies and don't identify you personally.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: Form data is used only to contact you, answer your questions, and carry out an audit you asked for.
Anonymous statistics help us understand which pages are useful and improve the site. We don't use the Meta Pixel or any advertising trackers.

sections.title: Cookies
body: This website stores a single functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) to remember your language choice. It isn't used for tracking.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Form data is kept for as long as we need it to talk with you, and no longer than 12 months after our last contact, unless you become a client and the data is needed for the work or for legal obligations.

sections.title: Third parties
body: We rely on third-party services to run this website: a form service (to deliver form submissions to our inbox), a cookie-free analytics service, and our hosting provider. We never sell your data or share it for advertising.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask for a copy of your data, a correction, or its deletion at any time by emailing hello@jcflowmedia.com. We'll respond as soon as we can.

sections.title: Contact
body: Questions about this policy can be sent to hello@jcflowmedia.com.
